admissibility_rules: A student is counted if they are enrolled in exactly one of the subjects.

hidden_solution_path: Calculate the number of students taking only Mathematics: |M| - |M ∩ S| - |M ∩ E| + |M ∩ S ∩ E|.

Calculate the number of students taking only English: |E| - |E ∩ M| - |E ∩ S| + |M ∩ S ∩ E|.
Sum the results to find the total number of students taking exactly one subject.
